payload.title: Specify search (07_text_search.feature, 08_vector_search.feature red)
payload.description:
Specs first, red before green; no production code in this task.

**Files:** `features/02_querying/07_text_search.feature` (new, @wip); `features/02_querying/08_vector_search.feature` (new, @wip); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs` (red); `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (embed both).

**Specs:** text — find sessions and messages by words across every source, ranked, case-insensitive; no match is an empty result, never an error; search composes with filters. Vector — with the deterministic stub embedder configured, semantic search returns the nearest sessions for a query text with scores; k is caller-chosen; text + vector results merge into one hybrid ranking (reciprocal-rank fusion); a store opened without an embedder answers text search normally and semantic search with a clean empty result; stores never mix embedding models (meta model id).

**Acceptance:** executable red; @wip kept on both files.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
